name: node_group
description: Manages a DuploCloud AI Helpdesk AWS EKS managed node group.

attributes.name: workspace_id
attributes.description: ID of the workspace that owns this node group.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the node group.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Optional description.

attributes.name: scope_ids
attributes.description: Scope IDs that link this node group to a cloud provider account.

attributes.name: resource_group_id
attributes.description: ID of the resource group (EKS cluster, under an environment) this node group belongs to.

attributes.name: environment_id
attributes.description: ID of the environment that owns the resource group.

attributes.name: instance_types
attributes.description: EC2 instance types for the node group (e.g. t3.medium).

attributes.name: min_size
attributes.description: Minimum number of nodes.

attributes.name: max_size
attributes.description: Maximum number of nodes.

attributes.name: desired_size
attributes.description: Desired number of nodes (between min_size and max_size).

attributes.name: disk_size_gb
attributes.description: Root EBS volume size in GiB for each node.

attributes.name: capacity_type
attributes.description: Capacity type (e.g. on-demand vs. spot). Accepted values are defined by the backend EksNodeGroupCapacityType enum; confirm the exact value against your tenant.

attributes.name: ami_type
attributes.description: AMI type for the nodes. Accepted values are defined by the backend EksNodeGroupAmiType enum; confirm the exact value against your tenant.

attributes.name: additional_labels
attributes.description: Kubernetes labels applied to the nodes.

attributes.name: taints
attributes.description: Kubernetes taints applied to the nodes.

attributes.name: key
attributes.description: Taint key.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Taint value.

attributes.name: effect
attributes.description: Taint effect. Accepted values are defined by the backend EksNodeGroupTaintEffect enum (e.g. NoSchedule/PreferNoSchedule/NoExecute); confirm the exact value against your tenant.

attributes.name: allocation_tag
attributes.description: Allocation tag used to target workloads to this node group.

attributes.name: instance_visibility
attributes.description: Node placement visibility (public vs. private subnets). Accepted values are defined by the backend InstanceVisibilityType enum; confirm the exact value against your tenant.

attributes.name: provisioner_type
attributes.description: Provisioner type: Cli, IacNativeTf, IacDuploTf, or DirectApiCall.

attributes.name: provisioner_version
attributes.description: Optional provisioner version.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current provisioning status.

attributes.name: node_group_name
attributes.description: Provisioned EKS node group name.

attributes.name: node_group_arn
attributes.description: ARN of the provisioned node group.

attributes.name: stack_id
attributes.description: ID of the underlying provisioning stack.

attributes.name: kubernetes_version
attributes.description: Kubernetes version of the node group.

attributes.name: release_version
attributes.description: AMI release version of the node group.

attributes.name: asg_name
attributes.description: Name of the backing Auto Scaling group.

attributes.name: subnet_ids
attributes.description: Subnets the node group is deployed into.

failureStates.WaitingForApproval: provisioning is waiting for manual approval, which Terraform cannot provide
